name: Fort Thomas Coffee
address: 1 Highland Avenue, Suite A, Fort Thomas, KY
limitations: Current official visit and coworking information; no on-site audit. A public discussion suggested several seating options, but did not measure access. Entrance thresholds, door controls, parking-to-door route, toilets/changing facilities and table clearance remain unverified. Coworking is a paid, availability-dependent service, not a guaranteed quiet retreat. Event space descriptions do not establish personal assistance or an accessible route to every room.
facts: The café offers mobile ordering through its Order tab. The FAQ does not specify curbside handoff or carrying assistance; check collection arrangements before ordering.
Yes, we offer mobile ordering. Head to the order tab on this website, then order online. You are all set!
Wi-Fi and laptop use are welcome for paying customers. This is a shared café space, not a promise of quiet conditions.
Yes, we have Wi-Fi and are laptop friendly. Our space can be used for studying, business work, dates, meeting with friends, etc. We just ask that upon using our Wi-Fi, you are a paying customer!

The venue describes its closed-door coworking space as quiet, but access requires a day pass ($25 advertised) or Tower Membership and is available only when the Cannon Event Suite is not rented. Walk-ins are welcome; seats may be reserved online up to one week ahead, with priority for business off-sites and event rentals.
Buy a Day Pass or become a Tower Member to access our quiet, closed-door co-work space when the Cannon Event Suite is not rented.
Walk-Ins are welcome. Seats can be reserved online up to one week in advance. Priority booking is reserved for business off-sites and event rentals.

The meeting and event business center advertises complimentary parking and food and drink service directly to the table. This service description does not establish accessible parking bays, a step-free entrance or personal assistance; check the room and route when booking.
Fort Thomas Connect offers complimentary parking, exceptional hospitality, and a full food and beverage menu with direct-to-table service
The FAQ lists 6:30 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 6:30 a.m.–2 p.m. Sunday, with 859-999-8080 for questions. Check current hours and any event arrangements before travel.
